Model note: Replacement for the removed CLE/DET assist props. Jalen Duren Over 1.5 assists is widely posted at the main 1.5 line across bet365, Novig, FanDuel, DraftKings/Onyx, Fanatics, Fliff, ProphetX, and Sportsbook Rhode Island; bet365/Novig were best practical prices around -160. The -160 price breaks even at 61.5%, while the model estimates about 99.9%, a +38.4 percentage-point cushion and roughly +62.4% EV.
